scripts.build-functions: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'pnpm --dir functions run build && pnpm run build-functions-codebases'
scripts.functions-watch: ./scripts/with-node22.sh pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names functions,codebases --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "yellow,magenta" "pnpm --dir functions run build-watch" "pnpm exec turbo run build-watch --filter=functions-core --filter=functions-media --filter=functions-image --filter=functions-integrations --continue"
scripts.dev:prepare: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@upperroom/shared --filter=@upperroom/contracts --filter=functions-core --filter=functions-media --filter=functions-image --filter=functions-integrations --continue --force && pnpm --dir functions run build'
scripts.dev:process-audio: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'trap "pnpm run dev:process-audio:down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT INT TERM; pnpm run dev:process-audio:up; while :; do sleep 3600; done'
scripts.dev:emulators: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'mkdir -p dir dir/auth_export dir/firestore_export dir/database_export dir/storage_export && export SUBSPLASH_DEV_MAX_LIST_SIZE="${SUBSPLASH_DEV_MAX_LIST_SIZE:-3}" && export PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_SERVICE_URL="${PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_SERVICE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_HOST_PORT:-8080}}" && export PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_SERVICE_URL="${PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_SERVICE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_HOST_PORT:-8082}}" && pnpm exec firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage,tasks --import=./dir'
scripts.dev:emulators:mail: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'mkdir -p dir dir/auth_export dir/firestore_export dir/database_export dir/storage_export && node scripts/write-mail-emulator-config.mjs && export SUBSPLASH_DEV_MAX_LIST_SIZE="${SUBSPLASH_DEV_MAX_LIST_SIZE:-3}" && export PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_SERVICE_URL="${PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_SERVICE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${PROCESS_AUDIO_FILE_HOST_PORT:-8080}}" && export PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_SERVICE_URL="${PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_SERVICE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${PROCESS_AUDIO_YOUTUBE_HOST_PORT:-8082}}" && pnpm exec firebase emulators:start --config firebase.mail.json --only auth,functions,firestore,database,storage,tasks,extensions --import=./dir'
scripts.dev:stop: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'pnpm run dev:process-audio:down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; lsof -t -nP -iTCP:3000,4000,5001,8081,8123,9000,9099,9199 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | sort -u | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.dev: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'pnpm run dev:stop && pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,emulators,functions,process-audio --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "cyan,white,yellow,green" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:emulators" "pnpm run functions-watch" "pnpm run dev:process-audio"'
scripts.dev:mail: ./scripts/with-node22.sh bash -c 'pnpm run dev:stop && pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,emulators,functions,process-audio --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "cyan,white,yellow,green" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:emulators:mail" "pnpm run functions-watch" "pnpm run dev:process-audio"'
scripts.import-from-prod: gsutil rm -r gs://urm-app.appspot.com/firestore_export && gcloud firestore export gs://urm-app.appspot.com/firestore_export && gsutil -m cp -r gs://urm-app.appspot.com/firestore_export ./dir
